source_text: Dominus iubet dari eis possessionem inter fratres patris. Lex hereditatis expanditur misericordia.
pass_a_gloss: Lord orders to-be-given to-them possession among brothers of-father. Law of-inheritance is-expanded by-mercy.
pass_b_english: The Lord orders them [[possession among their father’s brothers >> Bible:Numbers 27:6-11]]. Inheritance law widens in mercy.
